svg.title: Firefox → Kit · 2100 ms
svg.desc: The supplied Firefox logo spins and scales in. Its fox uncoils into Kit, drops as the globe dissolves, then makes a single extended leap through the right edge. A flexible tail follows with inertia, delayed bending and damped recoil. Hand-drawn vectors; one 2100 millisecond SMIL animation; transparent background.
svg.metadata: Original Firefox path data and gradients: user-supplied firefox-svgrepo-com.svg. Kit artwork redrawn from the supplied visual reference. Timeline: 0–540 ms reveal; 540–945 ms continuous contour morph; 945–1260 ms descent; 1260–1410 ms anticipation; 1410–2100 ms one sustained leap and exit. Tail: eight connected spring-damped segments, body acceleration and gravity, skinning shared by the silhouette and highlights; motion baked into SVG paths.
